library: Two anthropomorphic adult cats facing each other in a cozy book room: an orange tabby man in a navy jacket on the left and a cream woman cat Jane in a green cardigan on the right. Jane offers one RED book to the man. A blue book lies on the table. A clearly visible shelf holds THREE ordinary transparent drinking glasses, and two different drinking glasses stand on the table. No other books or drinking glasses. Keep the shelf glasses large enough to distinguish from eyeglasses. Both cats have complete bodies, feet and tails within the frame.
clothes: In a cozy dressing room, two adult female cats admire a GREEN dress and matching GREEN hat displayed prominently together on a coat stand. One cream cat in a blue blouse and one brown tabby cat in a coral cardigan face each other. Also a separate WHITE shirt and a BLUE shirt hang to the side, large and recognizable. The green dress and hat are the focal point. No other clothing in the background. Both full-body cats stand naturally, gestures toward the displayed clothes.
customs: A friendly airport customs counter. On the left an anthropomorphic gray officer cat in a navy uniform. On the right TWO anthropomorphic adult traveler cats, one orange and one cream, stand together with TWO BROWN suitcases and present their small passport booklets to the officer. Friendly calm welcome, facing each other. No flags, emblems, visible text or nationality labels. Entire cats and luggage fully visible, simplified background.
office: An inviting small office with anthropomorphic adult cats. In the foreground two distinct male cats face each other: one silver cat in a green blazer and one orange cat in a navy blazer. Behind them two female cats sit at separate keyboards; to the other side a young black-and-white assistant cat carries a plain paper. The office is bright and organized, keep each figure's identity distinct. No signs or readable writing. Hand-painted classic animation, simplified computers and papers.
rest: At a pleasant park bench two tired anthropomorphic child cats, a cream girl and orange boy, sit beside their mother, a larger gray adult cat in a teal dress. To the right a friendly cream adult ice-cream vendor cat offers TWO ice cream cones. No extra ice cream cones anywhere. Soft daylight, complete bodies, clearly child-friendly neighborhood scene. Keep faces visible and the bench and vendor cart simple.
bedroom: An untidy bedroom in the middle of being tidied. Two adult anthropomorphic female cats, an older gray cat in a blue dress and young cream cat Amy in a coral shirt, face each other. Amy holds a broom angled toward the floor. Clothes lie on an unmade bed, a wardrobe stands open, a window is open, and a dressing table has a dust cloth. Keep furniture and clothes recognizable and not cluttered. No text or labels, complete characters fully visible.
bridge: A cheerful four-member anthropomorphic cat family walking ON a bridge over a river: adult gray father, adult cream mother, orange boy in blue, cream girl in coral. A BIG SHIP goes UNDER the bridge; two SMALL BOATS are farther on the river; ONE AEROPLANE flies OVER the river in a sky with a shining sun and a few clouds. Make the bridge, ship, boats and plane distinct and spatially unambiguous. All family members fully visible, no visual cropping of the ship's silhouette. Wide children's storybook scene, not a poster.
village: An educational panoramic view of a small village IN A VALLEY BETWEEN TWO HILLS. A river crosses the village. On the LEFT bank two anthropomorphic adult cats walk ALONG the river. In the water a boy cat with orange fur and a blue swimming vest swims ACROSS, close to the bank. On the RIGHT, a simple SCHOOL BUILDING is BESIDE a green PARK; two child cats walk OUT OF the school doorway TOWARD the park. Clear paths and positions; figures and buildings large enough to understand, uncluttered. No text, labels or letters.
bookcase: Two adult anthropomorphic male cats in a small workshop, facing each other with complete bodies visible. George is an orange tabby wearing a blue work apron. Dan is a gray cat in a green shirt, handing George a LARGE HAMMER. A SMALL HAMMER rests separately on the table. An UNPAINTED wooden BOOKCASE is next to George with one tin of PINK paint and a brush beside it. Paint has NOT yet been applied: the bookcase is entirely natural wood, showing what George plans to do next. Clear focus on bookcase, large hammer, small hammer and pink paint.
vase: A warm living-room scene with two anthropomorphic adults: Sam is an orange male cat in a blue cardigan and Penny is a cream female cat in a coral sweater. Sam carefully places ONE elegant ceramic VASE with a few flowers ON a sturdy SHELF. Penny gestures toward that shelf. A window and a separate small table are visible nearby, with no vases on them. Calm complete full-body staging; no broken glass, no danger. Only one vase so its location is unambiguous.
pantry: An educational kitchen scene of unpacking a grocery bag: a large paper bag ON a chair, and on a simple table neatly spaced a loaf of bread, a piece of yellow cheese, a wrapped bar of soap, a segmented chocolate bar, a bottle of milk, a plain sugar packet, a coffee tin and a tea tin. No brands or readable text. Two adult anthropomorphic cats, orange Sam in a blue cardigan and cream Penny in coral, face each other by the table, entire bodies visible. Distinguish bread, cheese, soap and chocolate strongly; do not make all objects identical packets.
tea: Two adult anthropomorphic cats making tea: orange Sam in blue and cream Penny in coral. A KETTLE with a small wisp of steam sits safely on a kitchen counter. A TEAPOT is on the table with a TEA TIN directly BEHIND it, still visibly peeking above. A CUPBOARD stands OPEN with THREE CUPS INSIDE. No cups on the table. Both cats fully visible and facing the preparation area with clear friendly expressions. Simple painted kitchen background, no readable writing.
letter: A small office scene, two adult anthropomorphic cats facing each other. Bob, an orange tabby man in a blue shirt, hands a paper letter to Pamela, a cream woman cat in a green cardigan sitting at a keyboard. Pamela tilts her head with a puzzled but friendly expression because the paper has scribbles; keep the scribbles abstract and not readable letters. Through the doorway, an adult gray boss cat in a navy jacket stands in the next office. No labels or UI. Entire main characters fully visible.
coffee: Two adult anthropomorphic female cats sitting at a small cafe table, facing each other: Christine a warm brown tabby in teal and Ann a cream cat in coral. Ann has ONE CUP OF BLACK COFFEE, clearly dark with no milk added. On the table a separate small sugar bowl, a small milk jug and a plate of plain biscuits. Christine offers one biscuit. Cozy quiet setting, clear objects and full upper and lower bodies visible, no brand text or signage.
market: A friendly neighborhood butcher shop with TWO adult anthropomorphic cats facing each other across a low counter: a gray butcher in a white apron and cream Mrs. Bird in a teal cardigan holding a shopping bag. On the counter are neatly wrapped simple food portions: one red steak, a small tray of minced meat, and a separate whole prepared chicken. No blood, knives, animals, gore or distress. Rounded stylized edible food shapes in a family animation painting, readable silhouettes, complete cats visible. Keep backdrop plain, no signs or text.
